reply.text:
Tweaky back is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't assess it or suggest how to work around it. If it's sore, a clinician is the right call before you load anything heavy.

What I can do is keep the training going around it. Tell me what you're able to do today and what you want to avoid, and I'll build it around that. I'll also need to know which squat variations or other movements you want me to steer clear of, so just let me know what to exclude.
